## Design

### 2026-10-26: Starting Point,

**3h**

Starting Point,

These first hours are the longest. This is my 2nd time making a keyboard and i'm hoping to actually get this one submitted if i can. For this board, I planned on using the nice!nano devboard, but there just wasn't enough io pins for my keyboard, so to keep costs low, i decided to just to use a waveshare devboard, the ESP32-S3-Devkit N8R8. Again, similar to most boards by waveshare, they don't have footprints nor symbols so I spend about 2 hours creating both. Another cool thing about this board, this one has a 3d model, and I don't believe any others do, which is super nice as I can use them to double check my footprint
